source: FA2 also changes work inside each thread block. FA1’s warp partitioning could require partial results to be written to shared memory and combined, creating communication overhead. FA2 repartitions work so warps cooperate in a way that reduces shared-memory reads/writes.[5]
zh: FA2 还改变了每个线程块内的工作。 FA1 的扭曲分区可能需要将部分结果写入共享内存并进行组合，从而产生通信开销。 FA2 重新分区工作，因此扭曲以减少共享内存读/写的方式进行协作。[5]
